iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

clear summer night in san francisco at fourteen degrees
calm wind over the bay before dawn

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Drag fake user silhouettes into glowing honeypot zones while letting genuine visitors slip through the gaps — misdirection as defense.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: satisfying snap when a decoy lands in its trap
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: visitors move faster and honeypot shapes mutate each wave

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap to lock floating UI widgets into orbit around a central agent brain — arrange panels before the interface collapses into chaos.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: watching a clean agent dashboard crystallize from scattered pieces
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: widgets spawn faster with conflicting gravity pulls

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe left/right between mountain ridges as an avalanche closes behind you — pick the safer lane before snow seals every exit.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: narrow escapes with snow eating the trail behind you
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: ridges narrow and avalanche speed increases each segment

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to charge a sunrise launch countdown, release to deploy tiny code capsules skyward — stack shipments before dawn breaks the horizon.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: chaining perfect releases to fill the dawn cargo arc
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind drift and tighter launch windows each wave
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: minimal amber dawn gradient with tiny rocket trails
